Settings

Interface

Interface scale
Zooms Figma, the tab bar, menus, prompts and this window together, like a browser's zoom

Color scheme

Themes

Pick a theme for light mode and one for dark mode. It colors Figma's panels, toolbars and menus and Ligma's tabs, but not the canvas.

Toolbar

Modes to switch between
On the right of Figma Design's toolbar. With one left, the switch is hidden. Hiding the mode a file is in switches it to the first one shown. Right-click the switch to change these there. Hiding one reloads files already open, each when you next look at it.

Development

Import plugin from manifest
Pick a plugin's manifest.json. Plugins that are on show in Figma's Actions panel, under Plugins & widgets, in files you can edit. They aren't sandboxed like in the Figma app, so only import plugins you trust.

Ligma
Ligma checks for updates on launch and every 6 hours

Help

Report a problem
Opens a GitHub issue with Ligma's version, your system and its recent log, for you to read and edit before sending. Nothing is sent otherwise.
